verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak banner layout. The logo shrinks to an illegible dot, the 'SUNSET SALE' kicker drops to the bottom line beside the fine print, and it sits on a cropped red ellipse fragment. The fine print is unreadable, and a cut-off grey circle stub sits at the far left edge. A is slightly worse: its subcopy runs almost into the CTA pill with only a few pixels of gap, and the oversized box fills the full height edge to edge. B leaves a bit more room between the copy and the CTA, but its centred text block still crowds the button.
